query: OSHA power generation release from lockout inspect equipment operationally intact before restoring energy

results.query: OSHA power generation release from lockout inspect equipment operationally intact before restoring energy
results.snippet: The work area shall be inspected to ensure that nonessential items have been removed and that machine or equipment components are operationally intact.
results.title: 29 CFR 1910.269(d)(7)(i), Electric power generation, transmission, and distribution: Release from lockout/tagout (OSHA)
